List the pinned models

Source: R/manifest.R
models.Rd

models() lists the pinned embedding models as a table: by default the columns needed to choose a model, and with detail = TRUE also the settings the package applies when encoding (pooling rule and input prefix), the inference engine, the license, and the repository and revision. Embedding models differ in the languages they cover, the length of input they read, the size of their vectors, and the disk and time they cost.

The package supports a fixed set of models, each pinned to an immutable Hugging Face revision and verified by file size and SHA-256 hash, so a model name identifies exactly one model. The result has one row per pinned model.

Pass a value of the model column to any argument that takes a model, for example encode(text, model = "bge-small-en-v1.5"), or to load_model() and model_download(). For a model outside the list, see load_custom().

Usage

models(detail = FALSE)

Arguments

detail

FALSE (default) for the columns model, dimensions, max_tokens, languages and size_mb; TRUE adds pooling ("mean" or "cls"), prefix (text prepended by encode()), engine ("onnx" or "static"), license, id and revision.

Value

A base data frame with one row per pinned model and the columns described under detail. size_mb is the download size in megabytes.

See also

load_model() and model_download() to use a model; model_status() to check an installation; load_custom() for other models.

Examples

models()
#>                                    model dimensions max_tokens      languages
#> 1                       all-MiniLM-L6-v2        384        256        English
#> 2                      all-MiniLM-L12-v2        384        128        English
#> 3                paraphrase-MiniLM-L3-v2        384        128        English
#> 4              multi-qa-MiniLM-L6-cos-v1        384        512        English
#> 5  paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2        384        128  50+ languages
#> 6                      all-mpnet-base-v2        768        384        English
#> 7  paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2        768        128  50+ languages
#> 8                      bge-small-en-v1.5        384        512        English
#> 9                       bge-base-en-v1.5        768        512        English

#> 12           jina-embeddings-v2-small-en        512       8192        English
